name: AHV pension, full record, at 65 and deferred to 70
workings: Born 1961-06-15; 44 Swiss contribution years at an average income of 100,000.00.
At 65 (2026): average 100,000.00; monthly 2,520.00 for a full record × 44/44 × 1.000 = 2,520.0000; a year 32,760.0000 (13 payments); the first year 6 months and their 13th: 16,380.0000.
At 70 (2031): average 100,000.00; monthly 2,520.00 for a full record × 44/44 × 1.315 = 3,313.8000; a year 43,079.4000 (13 payments); the first year 6 months and their 13th: 21,539.7000.
The average is above 72 × 1,260 = 90,720, so the maximum: 1.04 × 1,260 + 8/600 × A ≥ 2,520, capped at 2,520.
Deferred 5 years: +31.5%. No growth or drift (realWageGrowth and inflation 0).
